findings.evidence: `theorem mapL_congr {Ψ' : C.CoeffMap C'} (h : Ψ.toFun = Ψ'.toFun) : Ψ.mapL μ p k = Ψ'.mapL μ p k`
findings.fix: Replace the structure with a Prop-valued predicate, e.g. `SectionChartData.IsCoeffMap C C' (toFun : S → S') : Prop` (an existential over chart/domain/coeff). Define `mapL`/`mapEquivL` from `toFun` and that proof by choice; `mapL_congr` then becomes definitional.
findings.issue: `CoeffMap` bundles free data: `chart`, `domain`, and `coeff` away from `C'.image i` are left unconstrained. `mapL_congr` proves `mapL` depends only on `toFun`, so two `CoeffMap`s with equal `toFun` can be unequal and no `@[ext]` holds.

findings.evidence: Passed explicitly in Smooth.lean (`contMDiffCovariantDerivativeOn_sectionTransport`) and in Transport.lean (`tangentHomEquivL_mem_zeroOneSobolevSections`, `tangentHomEquivL_symm_mem_zeroOneSobolevSections`, `chartValueL_zeroOneTransportEquivL_symm_ae_coord`, `zeroOneTransportEquivL_comp_sobolevL`).
findings.issue: `toContinuousLinearMap_restrictScalars'` is the normal-form rewrite for the coercion of `restrictScalars'` to a map, but it is not `@[simp]`. Its siblings `restrictScalars'_toLinearEquiv` and `coe_restrictScalars'` are, and every consumer in this PR passes it to `simp only`/`simpa` by hand.

findings.evidence: Transport.lean: `rw [← ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe, SobolevSection.coe_tangentHomEquivL]` in `tangentHomEquivL_mem_zeroOneSobolevSections` and again in `zeroOneTransportEquivL_comp_sobolevL`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` lemmas `bundleEquivL_apply`, `bundleEquivL_symm_apply`, `tangentHomEquivL_apply`, `tangentHomEquivL_symm_apply` stating `e w = …MapL … w`, each proved by `(rfl)`.
findings.issue: `bundleEquivL` and `tangentHomEquivL` (and their `symm`s) have only coercion-to-map simp lemmas, with no pointwise `_apply` forms. Consumers must rewrite back to the map form with `← ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe` before `coe_tangentHomEquivL`/`coe_bundleEquivL` can fire.

summary: `SectionChartData.CoeffMap` carries chart, domain and coefficient data that its own `mapL_congr` shows are irrelevant, so it is not extensional. Two automation gaps also force manual rewriting in consumers: the realification-to-map lemma is not `@[simp]`, and the induced equivalences have no `_apply` simp lemmas.
